핵심이슈.summary:
## 오늘의 한국 경제 흐름 요약

한국 경제는 1분기 깜짝 성장을 발판으로 소비심리가 급반등하는 등 회복 신호를 보이고 있으며, 1년 기대인플레이션은 오히려 하락해 물가 안정 기대감도 동시에 높아지고 있다. 채권시장에서는 씨티가 내년 국고채 발행 규모 축소를 전망하며 보험사 수요 부진 등을 배경으로 수익률 커브 정상화 가능성을 제시해, 통화정책 기조 전환에 대한 시장의 기대가 반영되는 모습이다. 한편 에너지 분야에서는 사상 처음으로 전력망 민간 개방과 RPS(신재생에너지 공급의무화제도) 폐지 법안이 상임위를 통과하며 에너지 시장의 구조적 대전환이 본격화될 조짐을 보이고 있다. 대외적으로는 무디스 애널리틱스의 수석 이코노미스트 마크 잔디가 36년 경력 중 미국 증시와 실물경제의 괴리가 가장 크다고 경고해, 글로벌 금융시장의 불안 요인이 국내 경제 심리에도 잠재적 하방 리스크로 작용할 수 있음을 시사한다.

key_headlines.summary: Korea's May exports through the 20th jumped 64.8% year-over-year, while consumer sentiment index rose significantly by 6.9 points to 106.1, the largest monthly increase in 11 months.

key_headlines.title: Moody's Raises Korea's 2026 GDP Growth Forecast to 2.9% from 2.6%
key_headlines.summary: Global rating agency Moody's upwardly revised Korea's growth outlook, citing strong semiconductor momentum and robust first-quarter GDP performance that nearly doubled market expectations.

key_headlines.title: Seoul Apartment Monthly Rent Prices Hit All-Time High as Jeonse Market Tightens
key_headlines.summary: Seoul apartment and villa monthly rent prices reached record levels as jeonse lease availability dwindles, forcing renters toward costlier monthly rentals and intensifying housing affordability pressures.

sections.Hot Economy News: Korea's economic momentum strengthened in May with exports surging 64.8% year-over-year and consumer sentiment rebounding sharply by 6.9 points to 106.1, marking the largest monthly gain in 11 months. The positive economic data follows Q1 GDP growth of 1.694%, significantly exceeding market expectations of 0.8%. Moody's upgraded Korea's full-year 2026 GDP growth forecast from 2.6% to 2.9%, crediting strong semiconductor performance. Government officials emphasized middle-class economic recovery and continued momentum amid Middle East geopolitical stability. However, underlying uncertainties remain regarding global economic conditions and external shocks.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The Bank of Korea's May consumer sentiment index jumped to 106.1, the highest improvement in 11 months, signaling renewed consumer confidence despite previous economic concerns. The government's tax expenditure for 2026 is expected to reach record 28.5 trillion won, up 7.4 trillion won from 2022, reflecting expanded child tax credits and employment subsidies. The central bank is conducting structural adjustments to tax spending programs to prevent wasteful expenditures. Next week will bring crucial US economic data including first-quarter GDP and April PCE inflation figures, which are pivotal for determining Federal Reserve policy direction. Japan's April consumer prices rose only 1.4% due to government fuel subsidies, though real wages continue declining for the fourth consecutive year.
sections.Financial Markets: Kospi closed modestly higher amid profit-taking and holiday-related caution before the Monday break, while Kosdaq surged 5% for the second consecutive day driven by public growth fund expectations and substantial buying-side circuit breaker activation. Individual investors and ETF purchases have become critical drivers of stock market movements, with potential for Kospi to breach the 10,000 level if earnings guidance improves. Rising bond yields have attracted investor attention to bond-focused ETFs despite inflation pressures. The won-dollar exchange rate climbed to 1,517 won, reaching a 50-day high, while Bank of Korea officials assessed the currency movement as excessive relative to fundamentals. Foreign investors sold 13 trillion won worth of stocks but Kospi rebounded, challenging the 8,000 level amid cautious sentiment following Fed rate hike discussions.
sections.Industry & Technology: Lotte Energy Materials sold a 90% stake in subsidiary Lotte Ecowall to fund investments in high-value advanced materials including AI data center circuit boards, ultra-thin copper foil for semiconductors, battery foils for energy storage systems, and EV battery foils. The company plans to expand AI circuit board production lines at its domestic Iksan facility to meet growing demand. These strategic investments position Lotte to capitalize on the accelerating AI infrastructure build-out and energy transition trends. The company's portfolio realignment emphasizes future-focused material solutions across semiconductor, data center, and clean energy sectors.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul apartment and villa monthly rent prices reached all-time highs as the jeonse lease market tightens substantially, pushing tenants unable to secure traditional deposits toward costlier monthly rentals. Seoul apartment prices rose 0.31% week-over-week, marking the largest weekly gain in 16 weeks, with mid-to-lower-priced districts like Seodaemun recording 13-year highs in appreciation rates. The rental market restructuring toward actual homebuyers combined with jeonse scarcity is driving significant price increases in lower-priced apartment clusters. Co-living accommodations are rapidly expanding as alternatives to traditional rentals, with Seoul co-living investments doubling year-over-year. Despite population decline concerns, Seoul real estate prices remain resilient, with expert analysis focusing on income levels and housing supply constraints rather than demographic trends.
sections.International Economy: US stock indices posted consecutive gains with the Dow reaching record highs as April FOMC minutes revealed multiple Fed officials view potential interest rate increases as appropriate if inflation continues above the 2% target. The Fed's hawkish stance contrasts with President Trump's preference for lower rates, creating potential policy conflicts under incoming Fed Chair Kevin Warsh. US inflation remains sticky with April CPI at 3.8% year-over-year and April PCE data scheduled for release on May 29th. CME FedWatch data indicates a 51.1% probability of at least a 25 basis point rate hike by December FOMC meeting. Global bond yields continue rising amid persistent inflation concerns, with US 10-year Treasury yields breaching 4.6%.
sections.AI & Economy: Hancom will supply its proprietary AI agents to LG AI Research Institute's ChatExaOne generative AI platform through a strategic business alliance covering technology, services, and both public and private markets. The partnership focuses on integrating Hancom's document creation AI agent into ChatExaOne's web-based environment, targeting government and enterprise sectors. California Governor Gavin Newsom signed an executive order to address AI-driven job displacement through labor policy reforms, including subsidies for companies maintaining existing employees rather than replacing them with automation. China's courts are awarding compensation to AI-replaced workers as youth unemployment reaches 17%, while discussions on universal basic income progress in the UK, Japan, and South Korea to mitigate labor market disruption.
sections.Others: Central America serves as an optimal gateway for Korean companies entering the US market, as Korean firms benefit from existing FTAs with five Central American nations and these countries' FTA relationships with the United States, positioning them as nearshoring hubs. The Financial Supervisory Service strengthened internal control guidance for asset managers ahead of July implementation of accountability structures, emphasizing enhanced compliance in ETF operations and prevention of securities lending abuses. SpaceX delayed its Starship V3 launch citing launch pad technical issues, with plans for rescheduling within days; the test flight outcome could impact the company's planned Nasdaq IPO mid-next month. The US Democratic National Committee released a 2024 presidential election post-mortem analysis attributed Kamala Harris's defeat to failure in presenting compelling reasons for voter support and assumptions that Trump's public perception was already fixed.
